content.tagline: Solid hair care in a compact format
content.descriptor: Vegan Nature is a Korean brand of solid shampoo and treatment bars for B2B supply
about: Vegan Nature develops solid hair-care formats. The brand’s official materials connect the range with a vegan lifestyle, nature-derived ingredients and reduced use of plastic packaging.

The approved publication scope covers two shampoo bars — Citrus and Fruity Floral — and the Yellow Rose treatment bar. Formula, labelling, supporting documents and market-specific claims are verified separately for each project.
facts: Two shampoo bars and one treatment bar
Solid format with no medical claims published
Documents verified per market and project
